name: go-playground-version-leased-backend-operations
instr:
go-playground cannot currently bind observed backend versions to later formatting and execution. Add leases so the selected toolchain is used, stale observations can be recovered safely, and omitted leases preserve existing behavior.

Leases are opaque, deterministic identities of normalized backend and version values; changing either changes the lease. Current, previous, tip, and fallback observations derive leases from published values, preserving identity across memory and filesystem caches, refreshes, restarts, and fallbacks. The versions response adds observations without changing playground or wasm values. Browser decoding preserves backend identifiers and leases exactly.

A leased run or format reaches only its matching backend. Reject invalid leases before upstream effects without changing successful events or reconstructed files. Conflicts return HTTP 409 with the selected backend's current version and replacement lease; `BackendLeaseError` preserves both fields. Browser calls optionally carry leases. Dispatch uses the selected observation for formatting and remote execution. One conflict permits exactly one refresh and retry, then one reported error. Do not change unleased formatting, remote scheduling, WebAssembly output, errors, or completion.
